senses.gloss: c. (a contraction of גלוסביקא or גלופסיקא, Lesbiacus, Lesbiaca, v. כְּלוּפְסִין, לִבְסִים, קְלוּפְ׳, גְּלוּפְ׳; as to guttural before ל, v. גְּלוּגְדְּקָא) relating to Lesbos (an island of the Aegean Sea, noted for its fertility and luxuries), Lesbian, whence
[in Syriac] name of a brand of white flour (P. Sm. 726), a white and delicate bread (cmp. Athenæus Deipnosophistæ III, 111).
units: Tosef. Ber. IV, 15 שלמה של גלוסקין an unbroken loaf of g’luskin, opp. של בע״הב home-made.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 6:12">Dem. VI, 12</cite> buy for me <he>גְּלוּסְקָן אחד</he> ed. (accus.; Ms. M. <he>גלוסקא אחת</he>, Ar. <he>קין אחת …</he>, R. S. <he>קלוסקן</he>) one loaf &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:9:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קלוסקין אחת</he>; <cite ref="Eruvin 64b:5">Erub. 64ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="C00910"><he>גלוסקין</he></cite> pl.—
Pes. 6ᵇ he may find ג׳ יפה ודעתו עליה Rashi (ed. ודעתיה עילויה, Ms. M. יפיפיה) a fine gl. which he may have the intention of eating (in place of burning).

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> <cite ref="C00908"><he>גלוסקאן</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>גְּלוּסְקָאוֹת</he>, <cite ref="C00910"><he>גְּלוּסְקִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01351"><he>קְלוּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:16">Lam. R. to II, 12</cite> <he>גלו׳</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>קלסקין</he>); a. e.

senses.gloss: a superior sort of olives already pressed when appearing in the market (θλασταί, σταφυλίδες, v. Athenæus l. c. II, 56; cmp. כְּלוּפְסִין).
units: Ab. Zar. II, 7 זיתי קלוסקא המגולגלין Y. ed. II, 10 (Mish. זתים גלוסקאות, Bab. ed. 39ᵇ זיתי ג׳, Mish. Nap. קלוסטא, Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. גלגל: קלוסטא, קלוסטרא). Bab. ib. 40ᵇ (ed. Pes. a. oth. קלוסקא, Alf. early ed. גלוסטא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4). Y. ib. II, 42ᵃ bot. הן זיתי ק׳ וכ׳ zethé k’luska is the same as rolled olives. [Ex. R. s. 30 גלוסקאות, v. גְּלוֹסְקְמָא.]
